items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: J.D. had made that thing more or less famous when he was with Andy Kirk, him and Jimmy Forrest, the great Jimmy Forrest, tenor player out of the original

ctx.x: We had a thing we used to call "Hollywood"(?) where we just honked and went on, you know, back and forth. J.D. had made that thing more or less famous when he was with Andy Kirk, him and Jimmy Forrest, the great Jimmy Forrest, tenor player out of the original
